task.Description: Which experiment the participant completed. The two experiments had entirely separate participant groups.

Levels.facedetection: Whole scene visible; search until the face is fixated.
Levels.movingwindow: Gaze-contingent aperture; only the region around fixation is visible.

corrected_vision.Description: Answer to the question "Any form of corrective lenses?", typed at the start of the session.
